tenant_boundaries: eligibility operates on tenant-scoped snapshot passed by callers
failure_paths: every failed hard constraint remains explicit

findings.evidence: EligibilityContext carried safetyBlockedPersonIds but not safetyBlockedDeviceIds; device safety events were not enforced in shared candidate eligibility.
findings.impact: Heuristic and candidate-engine paths could propose assignments to safety-blocked devices even before worker execution.
findings.fix: Added safetyBlockedDeviceIds to context and hard safety_blocked rejection; wired candidate engine and heuristic normal/reuse paths.

findings.evidence: Person/device/station available windows were treated as overlapping rather than containing the full candidate interval.
findings.impact: A task could be planned mostly outside an availability window after only one millisecond of overlap.
findings.fix: Required candidateStart/end to be fully contained in one positive availability window for person, device and station.

findings.evidence: No test covered device safety blocking or availability-window containment.
findings.impact: Unsafe and out-of-window candidate acceptance was invisible.
findings.fix: Added four boundary regressions for safety-blocked device and person/device/station full-window containment.
